title: Exploring the Impact of Artificial Intelligence-Generated Content (AIGC) Tools on Social Dynamics in UX Collaboration
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: This study investigates how AIGC tools impact social dynamics in UX collaboration through focus groups and semi-structured interviews with UX practitioners. It explores conflict resolution, team culture, and future expectations for AIGC tools.
